item.title: NCB to discontinue international GBP cheque services March 13; cites declining global use of cheque instruments and elevated risk exposure
item.description: Effective March 13, the National Commercial Bank Jamaica Limited (NCBJ) will discontinue certain international cheque services denominated in Great Britain Pounds (GBP). This means NCBJ will no longer accept GBP cheques drawn on overseas banks for deposit to bank accounts or issue GBP drafts drawn on international banks. The post NCB to discontinue international GBP cheque services March 13; cites declining global use of cheque instruments and elevated risk exposure appeared first on IRIE FM.

item.description: The father of three-year-old Jayce Pinnock, who was shot and killed during a home invasion in Denham Town, Kingston on Saturday has succumbed to wounds sustained during the incident. He is 31-year-old shop operator, Kerrio Pinnock otherwise called Boysie.
